note: Which boss drops what, for Zul'Aman and Sunwell Plateau. Scraped from Wowhead's per-raid loot guides, then reviewed. The ONLY thing here a machine cannot infer from an item id - everything else (name, slot, type, unique) comes from the item database. Recipes, the Amani War Bear and Blood of Zul'jin are excluded: this lists gear, on the same grounds CLAUDE.md section 7 excludes gems. ZA's four timed hostage chests are folded into one 'Timed Chest' source - chests 3 and 4 share all five rings, and the loot question is which source, not which chest. The six Sin'dorei Pendants and Bands are item level 141 against the raid's 154-164, which looks like a reputation reward and is not: the Eredar Twins and M'uru really do drop them. Item level is not a reliable test for what belongs here. The nine tier tokens on Eredar Twins are NOT an error - they can drop any token from an earlier boss, which is why the three Kalecgos bracers, three Brutallus belts and three Felmyst boots all appear again there.
